words.label: WHAT’S ON THIS MONTH?
words.body:
Expect exhibitions, workshops, installations and hands-on activities across the city.

At *Golden Thread Gallery*, visitors can make mini photo frames alongside its current exhibitions, while *Vault Artist Studios* launches _Time of the Signs: Border Crossing_, featuring work by more than 40 artists.

*Bramble Studio* is also joining in, with free chances to try pottery painting, wheel throwing, rug tufting and neon painting.
words.details: *A Digital Map will also be available to help plan your night across 40+ locations*
